## Experience

- Cornerstone Planning Group — AI Product Engineer (Consulting) (Jan 2025 – Aug 2025): Solo engineer building a custom retrieval system over disorganized historical documents
- MDA Space — Senior Software Developer (Dec 2023 – Aug 2025): Led a team of engineers and domain experts working on C++ enhancements for satellite ground-segment systems
- Amazon Web Services — Software Development Engineer, S3 (Jul 2021 – Nov 2023): Designed high-throughput systems on native AWS infrastructure
- ACD Systems — Software Developer (May 2014 – Jun 2021): Developed multiple features for a real-time C++ photo editor
